domain.text: vmethod gateway task lifecycle and merge-watcher behavior

impressions.text: The delivery addressed held-task release/start behavior and merge events for task PRs without workers.

The worker initially reported an incomplete, unverified implementation and stopped; the orchestrator clarified the required work, after which the worker reported completing the acceptance cases and verification.

The thread records weaknesses during delivery: release tests initially failed, the first pushed head had red CI, and a later concurrent test run had timing failures; subsequent checks passed after fixes and a standalone rerun.
Review identified branch conflicts after dev moved; the worker merged dev, reported preserving both sides’ behavior, and reported green CI and verification on the updated head.
